title: Praxis with a constrained rank-three Module-SIS lift for passing stacks
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 7851 MiB (7.6666 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 27215 million field multiplications (19566 and 7650), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, StackSIS, msis_bound) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
